sourcePlatformLogic: local CSS transforms + SVG connector motion + pointer-responsive parallax, inspired by evidence-board and UI interaction patterns
whyThisTemplate: The scene explains that reader promise is proven through action, relationship, information gap, object detail, and state change. An evidence board makes these causal links visible.

motionJobs.entrance: evidence cards pop in as separate proof points
motionJobs.reveal: red thread draws connections between cards
motionJobs.emphasis: focus lens highlights the decisive proof
motionJobs.transition: board parallax settles into the next chapter model
motionJobs.exit: connected proof resolves into a short takeaway

semanticBinding: The first card appears when narration says action, the connector draws through relationship/information gap, and the focus lens lands when state change is mentioned.

remotionMotionPrimitives.adoptionBoundary: Borrow frame-driven motion grammar while keeping html-video as the current renderer.

frameDrivenTimeline.rule: Every visual state change is reproducible from scene start/end time and render frame.

scenes.frameClock: derive progress from render frame or scene-local currentTime
scenes.textMotion: animate text as grouped semantic blocks so exact Chinese copy stays crisp
scenes.transitionDiscipline: record overlapped transition frames in sync-timecode-plan before render

interactionFeeling: Pointer/parallax behavior and focus-lens movement make the rendered frame feel inspected rather than static.
fallbackPolicy: If rendering falls back to FFmpeg/PIL, preserve evidence cards, connector progression, focus highlight, caption safe area, and timing order.
verification: confirm visible pixel difference between timestamps
confirm subtitle safe area remains readable
rejectList: static evidence cards with no connector motion
